paper_metadata.title: Microstructural Stability and Properties of New Nickel-Base Superalloys with Varying Aluminium:Niobium Ratio

evidence.quote: Of particular interest are the polycrystalline Ni-base superalloys that are used extensively in aerospace propulsion.

The microstructure and thermal stability of a series of new polycrystalline Ni-base superalloys with varying Al:Nb ratio were investigated, with comparisons made to commercially used alloys such as IN718 and 718Plus.
